privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.effective: Effective date: 4 July 2026 | Controller: LegalDesk Ltd.
privacy.section1Body: LegalDesk ("we", "us", "our") provides a cloud-based contract lifecycle management platform. We act as data controller for account data and as data processor for documents and signatures you process through our service.
privacy.section2Item1: Account data: name, email address, password hash, avatar.
privacy.section2Item2: Signing data: signature images, field values, IP address at time of signing, optional geolocation (only if you opt in).
privacy.section2Item3: Usage data: page visits, feature interactions (analytics cookies only if consented).
privacy.section2Item4: Audit data: timestamped log of all actions on every document for legal validity.
privacy.section3Item1: Contract (Art. 6(1)(b)): Account management, sending and receiving signing requests.
privacy.section3Item2: Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)): Security logging, fraud prevention, platform stability.
privacy.section3Item3: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): Analytics cookies, geolocation capture, marketing communications.
privacy.section3Item4: Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)): Retaining signed documents as required by applicable law.
privacy.section4Body: Signatures created through LegalDesk constitute Advanced Electronic Signatures under EU Regulation No 910/2014 (eIDAS) and are legally binding under the U.S. Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act (ESIGN). The audit trail stored per document constitutes the evidentiary record of intent to sign.
privacy.section5Item1: Signed documents and their audit trails are retained for 7 years unless you submit an erasure request and no legal hold applies.
privacy.section5Item2: Unsigned draft documents are automatically purged 90 days after last activity.
privacy.section5Item3: Account data is deleted within 30 days of account closure, subject to legal hold.
privacy.section6Body: You have the right to access, correct, export, or erase your personal data. You may also object to or restrict certain processing. To exercise any right, submit a Data Subject Access Request:
privacy.section6Footer: We will respond within 30 days (Art. 12(3)). For erasure requests, signed documents under legal hold will be anonymised rather than deleted — signature metadata required for legal validity is retained.
privacy.section7Body: Data is stored in EU data centres. Where sub-processors are located outside the EEA, we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission.
privacy.section8Body: We use the following key sub-processors: cloud hosting provider (EU region), email delivery service, and AI inference service (document summaries — text only, no PII transmitted). A full list is available on request.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1Body: By creating an account or using LegalDesk you agree to these Terms. If you are acting on behalf of an organisation, you confirm you have authority to bind that organisation.
terms.section2Body: LegalDesk provides a contract lifecycle management platform allowing users to upload documents, designate signatories, and collect legally binding electronic signatures. Features include audit trails, document templates, real-time collaboration, and AI-generated document summaries.
terms.section3Body: Signatures created on LegalDesk meet the requirements of Advanced Electronic Signatures under EU eIDAS Regulation 910/2014 and are legally binding under the U.S. ESIGN Act. The audit trail constitutes evidence of intent to sign and document integrity.
terms.section4Item1: You must provide accurate account information and keep credentials confidential.
terms.section4Item2: You must only upload documents you have the right to circulate.
terms.section4Item3: You must not use the platform to execute illegal agreements or to circumvent any law.
terms.section4Item4: You are responsible for ensuring recipients have agreed to receive documents electronically.
terms.section5BodyBefore: You retain ownership of all documents and data you upload. We do not sell your data. We process it solely to provide the service as described in our
terms.section6Body: Document summaries are generated by an AI service using the text content of your documents. No personally identifiable information (PII) from the body of the document is stored by the AI provider beyond the processing window. AI summaries are informational only — they do not constitute legal advice.
terms.section7Body: Signed documents are retained for 7 years to comply with applicable laws. Draft documents are automatically deleted after 90 days of inactivity. You may request early deletion subject to legal hold obligations.
terms.section8Body: LegalDesk is provided "as is". We are not liable for indirect or consequential damages. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid by you in the 12 months preceding the claim.
terms.section9Body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the European Union and, where applicable, the laws of France. Disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Paris, France.
terms.section10Body: We may update these Terms. We will notify you by email at least 14 days before material changes take effect.

capabilities.title: Capability map
capabilities.subtitle: How LegalDesk answers the contract lifecycle requirements, capability by capability — with an honest status for each.
capabilities.footnote: Statuses reflect what is actually running in this build. “Available” means you can exercise it in this demo today; “In progress” means the foundation is in place and the remaining work is scoped; “Roadmap” means it is designed but not built.

generation.title: Contract generation and templates
generation.desc: Reusable HTML and PDF contract templates with dynamic parameters, fields auto-filled per contract type, and AI generation from a plain-text brief. A shared clause library of approved bilingual wording — with categories, versioning and a draft/approved lifecycle — is insertable straight into a template. Any wording can be made conditional: it appears only when a field the template already collects satisfies a comparison you choose. Those conditions are deterministic tests over that one field — not a rules engine, and no AND/OR or nesting — and they are evaluated by the same renderer for the signing screen and the signed PDF, so both always agree.

aiReview.title: AI-assisted contract review
aiReview.desc: Every uploaded contract gets an instant rules-based scan and a pre-signature summary. From the contract page, a full legal-model review can be run on demand: it identifies the contract, flags missing, weak or contradictory clauses with severity and proposed wording, and extracts the next renewal or expiry date — falling back to the rules-based scan if the model is unavailable. A dedicated Contract Review desk runs that review automatically on upload and turns it into a readiness verdict with a tick-off list of adjustments; the verdict itself is a deterministic rule set over those findings — not a legal opinion — and sending a contract with unresolved critical findings is blocked.

workflow.title: Digitalised validation workflow
workflow.desc: Sequential, parallel or staged validation circuits with distinct Signatory, Approver, Legal reviewer and Observer roles, per-reviewer checklists, delegation, escalation and deadlines. Every step is traced.

versioning.title: Automatic versioning
versioning.desc: Requesting a revision pauses the circuit, archives the previous version with its change note, voids the collected signatures while keeping them as evidence, and restarts validation on the new version. Any archived version can be reopened or downloaded, and two versions can be compared clause by clause to show exactly which wording changed.

archive.title: Centralised secure archive
archive.desc: A single store for contracts and their annexes, access restricted to the owner and named participants, with every consultation, download, signature and comment written to a trace that exports to CSV.

obligations.title: Contractual obligation tracking
obligations.desc: A dated duty read out of the contract text at upload — a review, a milestone, a decision to take — proposed automatically and confirmed or overridden by the owner. A daily sweep raises each obligation to its owner as the deadline approaches. The contract’s own term is tracked separately, under execution monitoring.

reporting.title: Dashboards and reporting
reporting.desc: Organisation-wide contract activity: volumes over time, completion rate, average validation time, deadline compliance and revision cycles, broken down by contract type and by department.

execution.title: Execution monitoring and alerts
execution.desc: Email, in-app and real-time channels fire on signing deadlines, reminders and escalations. Executed contracts are swept once a day against the term recorded on them: the owner is alerted 90, 60, 30 and 7 days before expiry, again the day the notice deadline passes, and once the contract has lapsed — each milestone exactly once. From the notice deadline onwards the alert also reaches administrators and managers, so a departed owner is never the only person told. The sweep reads the dates entered on each contract; it does not monitor anything outside LegalDesk.

regWatch.title: Integrated regulatory watch
regWatch.desc: A legal-team-curated registry of Tunisian, European and sector-specific texts — data protection, consumer, telecom, commercial — each publishable with an effective date and an optional contract-family scope. Curation and publication are legal-team actions today, not an automated crawler of external sources.

compliance.title: AI compliance analysis
compliance.desc: On demand from the contract page, a full legal-model review confronts the contract with every published regulatory text and returns, for each one, whether it is addressed, a gap or unclear — with the reasoning, the consequence, and the clause wording that would close the gap. It judges substance rather than the presence of keywords, and grades each gap so the review desk can rank it. If the model is unavailable the check degrades to the keyword scan and says so on the panel. It remains an analysis, not a legal opinion.

riskMap.title: Regulatory alerts and risk mapping
riskMap.desc: Publishing a regulatory text immediately notifies the owners of in-force contracts it applies to, and the reporting page aggregates every contract's risk analysis into a portfolio-level map — severity distribution, most frequent risk clauses, and exposure by contract family.

hero.title: Contract lifecycle management, simplified.
hero.subtitle: Draft, route, sign and track contracts in one place — with a full audit trail from first draft to final signature.

signatures.title: Legally binding e-signatures
signatures.desc: Send contracts for signature and collect legally binding approvals in minutes.

workflows.desc: Route contracts through review, approval and sign-off with clear ownership at every step.

traceability.title: Full traceability
traceability.desc: Every action is logged, timestamped and auditable — from upload to final execution.
